issue: Product events occur after the stated as-of date
handling: Retain in raw; exclude from all as-of reporting and analysis.
escalate: Data Platform: determine whether synthetic extract leakage mirrors a real watermark problem.

issue: CRM account domains are shared by multiple account records
handling: Do not auto-merge: billing/account_id remains grain; surface duplicates for MDM review.
escalate: RevOps/Finance: decide legal-customer vs corporate-family identity and canonical account mapping.

issue: CS API duplicate snapshot IDs across pages
escalate: CS/Data Platform: API pagination should guarantee stable page boundaries.

issue: CS API rate limit response encountered
handling: Honor retry_after_seconds and retry_url; log both failed and successful calls.

issue: Future-starting replacement subscriptions already marked Active
handling: Do not use status as the historical activity predicate; use effective term dates.
escalate: Billing Ops: confirm whether Active means configured/current-record rather than economically effective.

issue: Opportunity currency differs from account billing currency
handling: Trust opportunity.currency for deal conversion; flag mismatch rather than overwrite.
escalate: Sales Ops/Finance: confirm allowed cross-currency deals.

issue: Opportunity stage transitions occur after the stated as-of date
handling: Exclude future transitions when reconstructing stage as of today.
escalate: Data Platform: enforce extraction watermark for point-in-time datasets.
